description: Land Acquisition - Pahala Beligalla, Beliatta D/S Division, Hambantota District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition notices under the Land Acquisition Act. It provides detailed descriptions of specific land parcels being acquired by the government for public purposes, including lot numbers, land names, descriptions of the properties, claimants, and exact land extents. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" and focuses entirely on land/property matters, fitting the definition of Type 4 (Land Gazettes) for land acquisitions and property-related administrative notices.
